candidates.formal_type:
{C : Type u_1} →
  {ι : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_3, u_1} C] →
      [inst_1 : CategoryTheory.Abelian.{u_3, u_1} C] →
        {c : ComplexShape.{u_2} ι} →
          {S :
              CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.{max u_2 u_3, max (max u_2 u_1) u_3}
                (HomologicalComplex.{u_3, u_1, u_2} C c)} →
            CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.{max u_2 u_3, max (max u_1 u_2) u_3} S →
              (i j : ι) →
                ComplexShape.Rel.{u_2} c i j →
                  Quiver.Hom.{u_3, u_1}
                    (HomologicalComplex.homology.{u_3, u_1, u_2}
                      (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.X₃.{max u_2 u_3, max (max u_1 u_2) u_3} S) i)
                    (HomologicalComplex.homology.{u_3, u_1, u_2}
                      (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.X₁.{max u_2 u_3, max (max u_1 u_2) u_3} S) j)
